description: CKEditor plugin for color button functionality, including color palette UI and style application.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the color button plugin, adding color palette buttons to the editor UI.

methods.name: addButton
methods.description: Creates and adds a color palette button to the editor UI with color options.

methods.name: renderColors
methods.description: Generates HTML for the color palette, including color options and 'More Colors' button.

methods.name: isUnstylable
methods.description: Checks if an element is unstyleable based on attributes.
